entity-definition.master.ts.role: primary fixture: entity geometry / ports / power for valley4-relevant devices

base-definition.master.ts.role: base definitions incl. valley4_protocol_core (70x70, builtin hub + external bus)

registry.tag-1.1.2.9.historical.ts.role: historical reference ONLY — contains known-wrong fields (protocol storage box requiresPower:false, later fixed upstream); kept as evidence of upstream drift, never as rule authority

trust_model.rule: upstream provides candidate rules; owner in-game adjudication is the only authority (rules_audit_20260718 SOP)

confidence_levels.owner_adjudicated: field confirmed by owner in-game test on game v1.1 valley4 protocol-core base
confidence_levels.upstream_only: field present in upstream data but not owner-verified; must be adjudicated before consumption

blacklist: outerRing subsystem (all versions): parameters contradict between upstream versions (4/2/2/4 vs 5/5/5/5) and owner in-game test shows NOTHING can be placed outside the 70x70 area; ignore OuterRingAllowed/InnerRingNotAllowed tags entirely
IP tag numbers are NOT game version numbers (v1.1.0-beta pre-adapted unreleased game content); cite commits, never tags
owner_adjudicated_fields_20260718: protocol_storage_box: 3x3, 3 input (one side) + 3 output (opposite side), four orientation modes, requiresPower true, 6 dual-role cache slots, wireless only box->warehouse

protocol_core: 9x9, 14 universal warehouse-sink inputs (7+7 opposite sides pos 1-7), 6 universal warehouse-pickup outputs (3+3 opposite sides pos 1/4/7), no power needed, is the base power source, no own coverage range, builtin+movable
power_diffuser: 2x2, 12x12 coverage (powerRange 5+6 async clip), powered from hub unconditionally at any distance

unloader (boundary pickup port): 3x1, single output port middle cell, must sit against the hongs bus which is FIXED OUTSIDE the base on two edges in game v1.1 — project's 'left/bottom boundary' equivalence is correct
outermost ring of 70x70: machine bodies CAN occupy it, belts CAN run and turn on it; a port whose front cell falls outside the base is dead; belts cannot leave the base
cross junction: perpendicular straight channels only; curved belt incompatible; parallel same-axis foreign belt blocks
item_log_admission (filter pass-through): exists in game, deliberately NOT modeled (geometry-equivalent to straight belt; filtering is throughput-scope)
